title: Splunk platform security
description: Watch the people who can change your SIEM. Who changed roles and capabilities, edited .conf files or knowledge objects, what they searched, and how the REST API is used. Everything comes from Splunk's own _audit data.

requiredData.notes: No add-on needed: every step reads Splunk's own _audit index (and splunkd_access in _internal). Searches need a role that can read _audit.

industrySources.control: Securing Splunk Enterprise: audit Splunk activity (_audit)
CIS Control 8: audit log management, applied to the SIEM itself

curationNotes: Five steps on purpose. Do not pad with MLTK or cluster UCs.
UC-13.1.37 and UC-13.1.39 carry requires_sme_review on compliance rows; clear before publishing.
